newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in busy trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed unchanged at 475.50/476.50 per dollar Thursday, in quiet trading, traders said.
"In general terms, the market was pretty quiet," one trader said.
Traders added that the Central Bank was as usual careful to meet demand for foreign currency when it arose, in order to hold the exchange rate unchanged.
Traders said they expected the exchange rate to remain little changed Friday as the Central Bank continues to control the bolivar's depreciation.
